defects.claim_says: First end 1980-10-16 (signing of EO 12248). The same reason says the rates were replaced by the 12248 schedules effective October 1, 1980 or the first applicable pay period on or after that date, and that 'the earlier effective reading is noted for review'. research_rationale says 'the replaced rates stopped operating up to about two weeks before the signing date; a reviewer should note this earlier effective reading'.
defects.source_says: EO 12248 sec. 1-201 makes the uniformed-services rates 'effective on October 1, 1980' and all other pay effective from the first applicable pay period beginning on or after October 1, 1980. Sec. 1-202 supersedes EO 12200. The claim says the rate commands stopped operating before the date it records, but gives no legal reason why that operation does not mark their first end. It hands the question to the reviewer while unresolved_material_gaps is []. The project's sibling claim (EO 10955) uses a retroactive 'effective as of' date as the end, so the treatment is inconsistent. Owner ruling 2026-10-28 item 5: the producer must decide this, not route it.
